title: Warmly Spiced Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A peppery and romantic Uruguayan dish featuring red chilli flakes and a ferment, this Whole30-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion. The aerated texture of the beef adds a unique twist to traditional skewers.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together red chilli flakes, black pepper, and sea salt.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill for 10 minutes per side.
While the skewers are grilling, mix the garlic and apple cider vinegar in a small bowl.
After the skewers have finished grilling, brush them with the garlic and vinegar mixture.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
